reason: The cited evidence shows Al additions promote SRO in an Al0.27CoFeNi alloy (E2), but does not demonstrate this effect in NbMoTaW, nor does it link SRO to improved room-temperature ductility or retained high-temperature/irradiation performance. The claim that SRO can be systematically engineered is explicitly stated as elusive (E1).
premises: Al additions promote short-range ordering (SRO) in HEAs
SRO can be systematically engineered in HEAs
SRO improves room-temperature ductility in HEAs
SRO does not compromise high-temperature mechanical performance
